sourceRefs.locator: ARTEM 4511, Archives nationales AE II 6 (K 2 no. 3). Header, regest and ll. 3–4, naming the king’s parents Dagobert and Nanthild as buried in the basilica. Clichy, 22 June 654.
pp. 353–355, particularly p. 354. Royal confirmation of Landry’s privilege, sung praise on the model of Agaune, signatories and the king’s parents.
List of works, section II “Le pouvoir et ses témoignages”, nos. 15–16, catalogue pp. 25–26. Dimensions and date of Clovis II’s charter and the 629–639 range for Dagobert’s AE II 3.

summary.de: Das 654 in Clichy ausgestellte Dokument nennt Dagobert und Nanthild und bestätigt der Gemeinschaft ein Privileg.
summary.en: The act issued in 654 at Clichy names Dagobert and Nanthild and confirms a privilege for the community of Saint-Denis.
